basics.name: Suparnojit Sarkar
basics.label: Applied Scientist 1
basics.summary: Applied Scientist 1 at Glance, working on LLMs, computer vision, and generative AI.

work.name: Glance AI (InMobi Group)
highlights: Worked on conversion of the Z Image base model from T2I to I2I using training-free techniques.
Worked on realism for image generation using LoRAs applied on Flux Klein and Qwen Image.
Working on a Multi Tryoff-Flatlay-VTON PoC along with moderation handling at inference time.

work.name: Cohere Labs
work.summary: Part of the Expedition Aya project.
highlights: Working on Tiny Aya Vision and safety representations across languages on Tiny Aya models.
Implemented a cross-modal weight merging strategy interpolating multimodal and base LLM weights with a tunable alpha, recovering text-only capabilities while preserving visual grounding performance.
Calculated refusal rate across all languages on Tiny Aya variants using LLM-as-a-judge (Command A) on the X-Safety benchmark.

work.name: CINT Lab, Indian Institute of Science
highlights: Implemented end-to-end pipelines for image/video generation using Flux.1-Dev, Qwen Image, and Wan 2.2 (text-to-image and image-to-video).
Fine-tuned Flux.1-Dev (LoRA) for Studio Ghibli-style image generation with 80% accuracy.
Applied zero-shot, few-shot, and CoT prompt engineering for image/video generation on ComfyUI.

work.name: VIML Lab, Indian Institute of Technology Mandi
highlights: Worked on semantic segmentation of unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing images under the guidance of Prof. Dinesh Singh.
Trained and evaluated the UAVid dataset using SegFormer and UNetFormer for image segmentation with PyTorch-Lightning, achieving an F1 score of 0.65.

projects.name: Fashion-Search
projects.summary: Built hybrid fashion retrieval using CLIP embeddings, K-means color extraction, and zero-shot scene classification with weighted re-ranking, enhanced with hierarchical indexing and inverted indices for 80% candidate filtering. Designed a semantic caching layer achieving 75-85% cache hit rates for sub-20ms response times. Fine-tuned CLIP ViT-L/14 with contrastive learning and hard negative mining, improving fashion-specific query precision by 15-20%.

projects.name: LegalAI
projects.summary: Developed a multi-agent legal document analysis system with 4 specialized AI agents (LegalAdvisor, ContractAnalyst, LegalStrategist, Team Lead) that process PDF contracts to deliver structured risk assessments, compliance checks, and actionable insights via a Streamlit UI. Integrated ChromaDB with Gemini embeddings for semantic search, configurable chunking, dual-party contract analysis, risk-based clause highlighting, and real-time chat.

projects.name: Polygon Colorizer
projects.summary: Built a diffusion-based conditioned U-Net (UNet2DConditionModel) to colorize grayscale polygon images using CLIP text embeddings from color descriptions, using PyTorch, Diffusers, and Weights & Biases for training, experiment tracking, and visualization.

projects.name: SLM for English Stories
projects.summary: Built a 30M-parameter Small Language Model (SLM) for short English story generation, designing the pre-training pipeline from data preprocessing to autoregressive text generation, and evaluating a transformer-based text generation workflow.
